title: Unit test for VersionInfo client component
body: The unit test tests/unit/ui/admin/version-info.test.tsx was removed because mocking fetch in a client component test with vi.spyOn() proved unreliable across test runs. The E2E test tests/e2e/admin-version-footer.e2e.spec.ts already covers this scenario end-to-end.
rationale: The unit test mock wasn't intercepting the global fetch call properly, causing undefined values. The E2E test is the reliable coverage path for this component.
